title: Planner Policy
description: Project-level planner defaults preserved at the repository root as planner.policy.yaml, planner.policy.yml, or planner.policy.json.

shape.description: Optional declared project shape for planner-core authority decisions, for example planner-core. When set, it wins over fallback inference.

domain.description: Optional declared project domain for consumer repositories, for example quant or frontend. Used when shape is absent.

default_route.description: Default routing preference for actionable engineering work. Questions, read-only actions, and ask-user decisions are not overridden.

compact_by_default.description: When true, low-risk doc/config/chore/static shapes may receive the compact verification scaffold.

enforced_for.description: Work families that require story-registry traceability by default.

ambient.description: When true, domain persona obligations are active as ambient project context.

surface_on_session_start.description: When true, bootstrap status surfaces ambient persona context at session start.

ambient.description: When true, IVE invariant awareness is active as ambient project context.

surface_on_session_start.description: When true, bootstrap status surfaces recent IVE invariant status at session start.

kb_reads_required.description: When false, skip-planner tasks do not require session-start KB reads.

transition_output.description: Preferred transition-output verbosity for project-local workflows.
